Graduate Power System Engineer 2027

at National Energy System Operator (NESO)

About 4.6/5
Summary Job Description

Job Details

Deadline: Ongoing
Salary:
£35,000 per year + £2,000 welcome payment
Job Type:
Graduate Scheme
Job Roles:
Information Technology
Engineering
Locations:
Warwick
Wokingham

Job Description

Our 18-month Graduate Programme is designed to help you build the technical knowledge, confidence and connections to make a real impact. Through three six-month placements across different teams, you’ll gain a broad view of how we plan, operate and transform the electricity system — from real-time control through to future system planning and strategy.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Graduate Power System Engineer, you’ll join the team working towards Clean Power by 2030. You’ll contribute to the big picture whilst learning fast on the job.

You could be:

  • Running power system analysis to explore risks and identify smarter network solutions
  • Helping develop new strategies for balancing the grid with more renewables
  • Collaborating with Transmission Owners to improve simulation models
  • Supporting strategic energy planning and whole-system thinking
  • Building technical publications used by government and industry
  • Engaging with regulators, stakeholders, and industry partners
  • Supporting new demand and generation connections
  • Contributing to the development of the Grid Code and operability tools
  • Developing and maintaining power system network models used for operational and future network studies
  • Helping model emerging technologies such as battery energy storage, offshore wind, HVDC links, hydrogen integration and flexible demand

What We’re Looking For

Degree Requirements: You’ll need a minimum 2:2 degree in:

  • Electrical, Electronic or Mechanical Engineering
  • Physics
  • Maths

Skills & Attributes:

  • An understanding of how energy systems work (or curiosity to learn fast)
  • Programming skills or a keen interest in data-driven analysis
  • Confidence writing reports, presenting ideas, and solving problems
  • A collaborative mindset and strong communication skills
  • Bonus: A full UK driving licence is desirable.

We actively welcome applications from women and those from underrepresented backgrounds in tech. If you’re looking for a place that supports you to grow, we’re here for it.

What You’ll Get

  • £35,000 salary + £2,000 welcome payment
  • Performance bonus
  • 26 days annual leave plus UK public holidays
  • Birthday day off – enjoy your birthday as a paid day off!
  • Structured training, mentorship and career development
  • Access to professional networks, learning pathways and volunteering opportunities
  • Work that aligns with your values – and drives impact for everyone

Why NESO?

We’re building a future where everyone has access to reliable, clean, and affordable energy.

At NESO, you’ll join a team that’s:

  • Curious and visionary
  • Purpose-driven and inclusive
  • Technically brilliant and always improving
  • Collaborative, diverse and human

Diversity, equity and inclusion are at the heart of what we do. We encourage applications from all backgrounds and are happy to discuss any reasonable adjustments you may need.

How to apply

To apply for this role and to find out more, please click on the apply button. Please note that applications may close before the application deadline, so apply early to avoid disappointment.

About National Energy System Operator (NESO)

We are the National Energy System Operator for Great Britain, making sure that Great Britain has the essential energy it needs by ensuring supply meets demand every second of every day. We sit at the heart of the energy system, harnessing our engineering and commercial expertise
